en: Fixed Artifact tool publishes after a conversation rewind (Esc Esc) overwriting a file's newer content that Claude had read only in the rewound turns; the publish is now refused until Claude re-reads the file
zh: 修复对话回退（Esc Esc）后的 Artifact 工具发布覆盖文件较新内容的问题，该内容 Claude 仅在回退的轮次中读取过；现在会拒绝发布，直到 Claude 重新读取该文件
